source_row.rationale: Seizure precautions for a client with a known seizure disorder typically include padding the bed's side rails (to reduce injury risk from movement during a seizure) and ensuring suction and oxygen equipment are readily available at the bedside in case of a seizure, while never restraining a client's limbs during an active seizure, since this could cause injury.
